patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Office Timeline share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Jira only if your buying job matches “Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo ” rather than Office Timeline's shape. Choose Office Timeline only if your buying job matches “PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite fro” rather than Jira's shape. Workflow advantage: Jira leans work-management; Office Timeline leans timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Office Timeline share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Jira is Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo annual.; Office Timeline is PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite from $9/user/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Jira-leaning work-management vs Office Timeline-leaning timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Jira — Steep learning curve outside engineering; Office Timeline — Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management.

Limitations — Jira: Steep learning curve outside engineering; Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth; Office Timeline: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution.

Poor-fit cases: Jira is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Steep learning curve outside engineering · Office Timeline is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management · Avoid Jira if you actually need Office Timeline's motion (PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
